pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyaṃ aññatarassa pūgassa saṅghassa sacīvarabhattaṃ paṭiyattaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.4: atha kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū yena so pūgo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.9: “bahū āvuso saṅghassa dāyakā. bahū saṅghassa bhaddā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.10: mayaṃ tumhe nissāya tumhe sampassantā idha viharāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.11: tumhe ce amhākaṃ na dassatha atha ko carahi amhākaṃ dassati?
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.13: atha kho so pūgo chabbaggiyehi bhikkhūhi nippīḷiyamāno yathāpaṭiyattaṃ cīvaraṃ chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ datvā saṅghaṃ bhattena parivisi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.14: ye te bhikkhū jānanti saṅghassa sacīvarabhattaṃ paṭiyattaṃ, na ca jānanti. chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dinnanti, te evamāhaṃsu:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.17: yathāpaṭiyattaṃ cīvaraṃ ayyā chabbaggiyā attano pariṇāmesu”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.18: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.19: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jānaṃ saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ attano pariṇāmessantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.20: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.21: “saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave jānaṃ saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ attano pariṇāmethā”ti?
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.24: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā jānaṃ saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ attano pariṇāmessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.26: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha –
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.27.1: “yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ attano pariṇāmeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.6: sāmaṃ vā jānāti aññe vā tassa ārocenti, so vā āroceti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.15: nissajitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.18: “idaṃ me bhante jānaṃ saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ attano pariṇāmitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.23.1: pariṇate pariṇatasaññī attano pariṇāmeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.24: pariṇate vematiko attano pariṇāmeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.25: pariṇate apariṇatasaññī attano pariṇāmeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.26: saṅghassa pariṇataṃ aññasaṅghassa vā cetiyassa vā pariṇāmeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.27: cetiyassa pariṇataṃ aññacetiyassa vā saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā pariṇāmeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.28: puggalassa pariṇataṃ aññassa puggalassa vā saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā cetiyassa vā pariṇāmeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.33: kattha demāti pucchiyamāno yattha tumhākaṃ deyyadhammo paribhogaṃ vā labheyya paṭisaṅkhāraṃ vā labheyya ciraṭṭhitiko vā assa yattha vā pana tumhākaṃ cittaṃ pasīdati tattha dethāti bhaṇati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.43: uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto tiṃsanissaggiyā pācittiyā dhammā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.52: [atirekakarattañca akālaporāṇadhovanaṃ, paṭiggahañca tañceva viññatti ca tatuttari, dve appavāritā ceva tikkhattuṃ codanāya cāti. missakaṃ suddhakañceva tulañca anuvassakaṃ, purāṇasanthatañceva lomānaṃ haraṇena ca, dhovanaṃ rujiyñaceva dve ca nānappakārakāti. atirekañca pattañca ūnena bandhanena ca, bhesajjaṃ sāṭakañceva kupitena acchindanaṃ, dve tantavāyā ceva accekacīvarena ca, chārattaṃ vippavāsena attano pariṇāmanāti.] tiṃsakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
